e22_esb_population: Four rows of the tail-silence-2s test media variant, chosen before any contact by naming the SAME four published segments the sealed 2026-09-05 test smoke selected -- 4479741-224 (the shortest), 4483338-281 (the longest and the window-fit worst case), 4485244-409 (the median) and 4485244-115 (the p90) -- each exactly two seconds longer than its v1 twin. Naming the segments rather than re-ranking by this variant's own durations is deliberate: it keeps the test cell's smoke on the same four recordings the sealed flight's smoke used, so a VRAM or encode surprise is attributable to the encoding factor and not to a different draw. The smoke's own WER numbers are on four rows and enter no verdict.
e22_esb_variant_factor: the acoustic tail: exactly 2.0 s (32,000 zero samples) of digital silence appended to every clip, so the speech offset is followed by the clamp-floor mel features a stop produces instead of being followed immediately by the encoder's own unmasked zero-pad block.
e22_esb_identity_hash_convention: e22_esb_split_identity_hash is data.splits.split_identity_hash(prefixed('earnings22-original', sample_ids)) over earnings22-original/<call>-<segment>@ts2, the value core.flight.FlightRuntime.preflight computes at flight time and the value an exposure row must carry. It differs from the flight cell's ecd9ab76... because four rows are not 2,735, which is why the smoke is a separate run id with a separate exposure row.
e22_esb_media_root: The variant WAVs live under $SPEECHRL_DATA_DIR/derived/e22-esb-utterances/test2735-tail2s-v1 and never enter Git. They are deterministic transformations of the sealed v1 test bytes, each source file re-hashed against the committed D1 media supplement before it was read; no parent MP3 was opened and no decoder ran.
e22_esb_d1_media_supplement: The @ts2 ids enter D1's identity closure through the additive media supplement named above (schema saea-d1-media-supplement-v1, the shape contracts.gate_media_identity reads); it chains to the same parent D1 identity artifact the v1 test supplement chains to, and binds to this population's own probe view through source_binding_sha256 aa5e677b.
e22_esb_split_role_basis: Identical to the flight cell's: the 2026-09-04 owner decision re-designated the six ESB test calls calibration-exposed after one read, and 'dev' is how calibration-exposed reaches the machine. This smoke is part of the SECOND read and is covered by the same owner GO the flight needs; four contacts on four already-read recordings are still four contacts, and they get their own exposure row.
e22_esb_reference_boundary: The 'sentence' column is gold and NEVER enters the request path. References live in the same hash-pinned test reference layer the sealed 2026-09-04 flight was scored against, unedited, and the published segment key is recovered by splitting the sample id on '@'.
e22_esb_window_fit: The four rows carry the variant's own worst encode: 4483338-281@ts2 at 38.360125 s and 507 speech tokens over five encoder windows, worst required 1582 against a 4,096-token slot, a ratio of 2.59x. Putting it through the live geometry before 2,735 contacts are spent is what this smoke is for.
e22_esb_exposure: Pre-flight 4-row dry run for SAEA-E22-ESB-SHORTFORM-TAIL2S-TEST-V1: same baseline, model and experiment protocol, only the dataset fragment differs. contracts.gate_exposure requires exactly one pre-registered exposure row per run id whose split identity hash equals the plan's, and four rows have a different split identity hash and a much smaller budget than 2,735, so the smoke cannot share a run id with the flight. This fragment grants no contact authority.
